questions.examTip: Structure your description in three parts: what you see, an opinion, and a personal link — this shows range beyond simple description.
questions.modelAnswer:
Sur la photo, deux adolescents sont assis sur un canapé, mais ils regardent tous les deux leur téléphone au lieu de se parler. Je trouve cette situation un peu triste. À mon avis, les jeunes devraient parfois éteindre leur portable pour profiter du moment présent avec leurs amis.

(English translation: In the photo, two teenagers are sitting on a sofa, but they are both looking at their phone instead of talking to each other. I find this situation a bit sad. In my opinion, young people should sometimes turn off their phone to enjoy the present moment with their friends.)

Useful phrases: au lieu de + infinitive; je trouve cette situation...; devrait + infinitive
questions.question: Describe this photo of two teenagers sitting on a sofa, both looking at their phones instead of talking to each other. Say what is happening, how you feel about this, and give your opinion on phone use among young people.

questions.examTip: Prepare flexible phrases for the unexpected question in advance; you cannot predict it exactly, but a stock structure (opinion + reason + example) will fit almost any topic.
questions.modelAnswer:
— Je passe environ deux heures par jour sur mon portable.
— On pourrait fixer une limite d'une heure le soir ?
— (Question imprévue) Les réseaux sociaux me sont utiles parce que je peux rester en contact avec mes amis qui habitent loin.

(English translation: — I spend about two hours a day on my phone.
— Could we set a one-hour limit in the evening?
— (Unexpected question) Social media is useful to me because I can stay in touch with friends who live far away.)

Useful phrases: je passe... sur mon portable; on pourrait fixer...; rester en contact avec

Media and technology
Key vocabulary

Revision focus
Practise present, past and future forms while discussing media, phones, the internet and technology. Build answers with justified opinions and precise examples.

Exam technique
- Spot time markers and negatives before answering.
- Use parce que/car to justify an opinion.
- Check adjective agreement, verb endings and whether the task asks for French or English.
